root_cause_analysis: The C14 explicit paid_ads net_gmv question compiles as scope_mode=explicit_multi_driver. For the conversion lane on channel, plan_compiler puts explicit_scope_policy=global_explanatory into action.args so ActionGate can permit a same-dimension global explanatory lane instead of forcing the paid_ads element directly. After the gate allows the action, ToolExecutor copies action.args into resolved tool args and validates them against SelectSignalElementArgs. That schema inherits StrictModel(extra=forbid) and does not define explicit_scope_policy, so validation fails before the tool runs. The DB trace confirms seq=10 action=select_signal_element, sql_audit_delta=0, query_count still 24, and all prior SQL audits passed. Because plan_compiler also adds the same scope metadata to fetch_related_signal and calculate_contribution actions, adding the field only to SelectSignalElementArgs would likely move the same failure one action later rather than fixing the boundary.

proposed_fix.description: Separate gate-only action metadata from deterministic tool inputs. Strip explicit_scope_policy from resolved tool args in the runtime tool boundary after ActionGate has evaluated it, or introduce an explicit internal-arg allowlist that is removed before pydantic tool schema validation for select_signal_element, fetch_related_signal, and calculate_contribution. Add a regression test for the C14 net_gmv explicit_multi_driver conversion lane proving the gate sees explicit_scope_policy but the tool schema does not receive it.
proposed_fix.estimated_impact: C14 should progress past E_select_ch_conversion into E3_ch_conversion/E4_channel_conversion without changing discovery lane generation, candidate ranking, SQL rendering, or score thresholds. The same boundary cleanup prevents identical schema-invalid failures on subsequent explicit_scope_policy fetch/calculate actions.
proposed_fix.negative_fix_warning: Adding explicit_scope_policy only to SelectSignalElementArgs is insufficient because later fetch_related_signal and calculate_contribution actions carry the same gate-only key. Suppressing this in ranking.py cannot affect a pre-tool schema validation failure.
